title: Equation satisfied by a successful split
statement: For $N\in\mathbb N$, if the bounded search for the least $i\in\{0,\ldots,N\}$ satisfying $i+(i+1)=N$ returns $i$, then $i+(i+1)=N$.
hypotheses_covered: The bounded search with target $N$ returns $i$
replaced: For $N \in \mathbb{N}$, consider the bounded search returning the least $i \in \{0,\dots,N\}$ with $i + 1\cdot(i+1)^1 = N$, if there is one. If the search returns $i$, then $i + (i+1) = N$.
